text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

One day, Ines Fujin was agonizing in front 
of a massive pile of Toughness Bars.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Well, listen to this. Yesterday at my 
temp job—"

text_block_list.name: Workplace Staff
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, a sales rep from one of our 
clients gave me a whole heap of Toughness 
Bar samples, but—

text_block_list.name: Workplace Staff
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally shoved it in the back and 
totally forgot to eat it.

text_block_list.name: Workplace Staff
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the expiration date is 
tomorrow. Take it with you if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So bringing it back was fine and all, but 
the sheer amount is absurd!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I did go around handing them out to 
everyone. But you see, with the expiration 
date being so close, I couldn't just give 
them a huge pile, right!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we have so much left over! 
Oh, what should I do? It'd be such a waste 
to throw it away.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, if I eat this much, surely 
I'll gain weight... won't I?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I do! I'm no good at 
stuff like this, I give up!
choice_data_list: Let's just eat it all at once!
Want to split it and eat half together?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ………… Aha, I knew it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I knew there was no other way! I was kind 
of thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I was just getting hungry, and we've got 
training coming up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if this makes me gain weight, 
you're my accomplice, so take 
responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You too!? Are you sure, though? It's 
a pretty big portion.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Setting an Umamusume like me aside... Can 
you actually finish all that? Won't your 
stomach give out?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case, pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just a third for now... No, even a fourth 
is fine! Please!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, that's true. Especially with 
that kind of portion...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a waste, but can't be 
helped, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm throwing it away before I 
change my mind!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...B-Before I change my mind!
